values: 巴登与幻影对指定敌人发动强力攻击，并使其无法恢复生命值和能量持续一定时间。
Baden and his phantoms unleash a powerful attack on a designated enemy, preventing the target from recovering HP and Energy for a duration.
巴登与场上幻影同时向指定敌人发起4段攻击并持续眩晕目标，前3段攻击各造成150% + 15% ATK伤害，最后一段攻击对目标及其周围1格范围内的敌人造成420% + 50% ATK真实伤害，吸收目标200% + 20% ATK生命并施加等量的生命削减。该技能还会使目标无法回复生命值和能量持续8秒。技能释放期间巴登处于无敌状态。自动战斗时，该技能优先选择最虚弱的敌人作为目标。

Baden and all his phantoms attack a designated enemy in unison, delivering 4 successive strikes and keeping the target stunned throughout. The first 3 strikes each deal 150% + 15% ATK damage. The final strike deals 420% + 50% ATK true damage to the target and enemies within 1 tile of them. It also drains 200% + 20% ATK HP from the target and inflicts an equal amount of max HP reduction. This skill also prevents the target from recovering HP and Energy for 8s. Baden remains invincible while casting this skill. In Auto Battle, this skill prioritizes the weakest enemy.
最后一段攻击伤害量提高至440% + 50% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the final strike to 440% + 50% ATK.
最后一段攻击伤害量提高至460% + 50% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the final strike to 460% + 50% ATK.
最后一段攻击伤害量提高至480% + 50% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the final strike to 480% + 50% ATK.
最后一段攻击伤害量提高至500% + 50% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the final strike to 500% + 50% ATK.
战斗开始时诅咒前方同一轴线上的敌人，在其生命值较低时召唤幻影协助战斗。
Baden curses enemies in a straight line in front of him when a battle starts, summoning phantoms to assist him when their HP is low.

战斗开始时，诅咒前方同一轴线上的敌人并对其造成250% + 30% ATK真实伤害，其中被诅咒的非首领敌人生命比例首次低于50%，或首领敌人每损耗巴登600%初始攻击力的生命后，在其周围产生一个能够释放普通攻击且优先攻击该敌人的幻影。幻影继承巴登60% + 5%的基础属性且处于无敌状态，每名首领敌人至多因此产生2个幻影。
主动释放时，巴登贯穿当前敌人，使其眩晕持续3秒，并偷取目标共20% + 2%最大生命值（不超过自身200% + 20%攻击力）和100点能量，随后造成240% + 30% ATK的伤害。

Passive. When a battle starts, Baden curses enemies in a straight line in front of him, dealing 250% + 30% ATK true damage. The curse summons a phantom near an afflicted non-boss enemy the first time their HP ratio drops below 50%. For afflicted boss enemies, a phantom is summoned each time they lose HP equal to 600% of Baden's initial ATK. Phantoms use normal attacks and prioritize the enemy whose curse summoned them. They inherit 60% + 5% of Baden's basic stats and remain invincible. Each boss can generate up to 2 phantoms this way.
Active. Baden impales his current target, stunning them for 3s and stealing 20% + 2% of their max HP, up to 200% + 20% of his ATK, along with 100 Energy. He then deals 240% + 30% ATK damage.
主动释放时造成的伤害量提高至260% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the active strike to 260% + 30% ATK.
主动释放时造成的伤害量提高至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the active strike to 280% + 30% ATK.
主动释放时造成的伤害量提高至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the active strike to 300% + 30% ATK.
巴登与幻影对敌人发动多段攻击。
Baden and his phantoms unleash multiple strikes on enemies.
与幻影同步释放5段斩击，前4段斩击总计对当前目标造成260% + 30% ATK伤害，最后一段斩击挥砍出剑气对周围2格范围内的敌人造成260% + 30% ATK伤害，并降低命中敌人20 + 2点受愈持续8秒，该效果可叠加至多3层。

Baden and his phantoms unleash 5 slashes in unison. The first 4 slashes deal a total of 260% + 30% ATK damage to the current target. The final slash sends out a sword shock, dealing 260% + 30% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles and reducing their Vitality by 20 + 2 for 8s. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
前4段斩击伤害量提高至280% + 30% ATK，最后一段战技伤害量提高至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases the total damage dealt by the first 4 slashes to 280% + 30% ATK and the damage dealt by the final slash to 280% + 30% ATK.
前4段斩击伤害量提高至300% + 30% ATK，最后一段战技伤害量提高至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases the total damage dealt by the first 4 slashes to 300% + 30% ATK and the damage dealt by the final slash to 300% + 30% ATK.
前4段斩击伤害量提高至320% + 30% ATK，最后一段战技伤害量提高至320% + 30% ATK。
Increases the total damage dealt by the first 4 slashes to 320% + 30% ATK and the damage dealt by the final slash to 320% + 30% ATK.
战斗中，自身提高9点穿透，战场上存在自身创建的幻影时额外提高6点穿透。
Baden increases his Penetration by 9 during battle, and by an extra 6 while any phantoms Baden created are on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高12点穿透，战场上存在自身创建的幻影时额外提高8点穿透。
Baden increases his Penetration by 12 during battle, and by an extra 8 while any phantoms Baden created are on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高15点穿透，战场上存在自身创建的幻影时额外提高10点穿透。
Baden increases his Penetration by 15 during battle, and by an extra 10 while any phantoms Baden created are on the battlefield.
“贯魂噩影”的诅咒效果增强，并且幻影在产生时还会窃取目标一定攻击力。
Enhances Wraithbrand's curse and allows phantoms to steal a portion of their target's ATK when summoned.
战斗开始时，巴登释放“贯魂噩影”诅咒敌人造成的伤害提高100%并且必定暴击，并且会附加相当于实际伤害量70%的生命削减。此外，幻影从诅咒中生成时会偷取目标15%攻击力，将其转移至巴登以及该幻影自身，每次偷取获得的攻击力不超过巴登初始攻击力的15%。

When a battle starts, the Wraithbrand curse deals 100% increased damage with a guaranteed critical strike, and inflicts max HP reduction equal to 70% of the actual damage dealt. Each phantom summoned by the curse steals 15% of its target's ATK, granting that amount to both Baden and itself. The ATK gained from each steal cannot exceed 15% of Baden's initial ATK.
偷取的攻击力提高至17%，每次获得的上限值提高至巴登初始攻击力的17%。
Increases the ATK stolen to 17% of the target's ATK and the cap for each steal to 17% of Baden's initial ATK.
战斗开始时，巴登立即从召唤一个幻影协助自身作战，该幻影优先攻击巴登当前目标。
Baden immediately summons a phantom to fight alongside him when a battle starts. This phantom prioritizes his current target.
偷取的攻击力提高至20%，每次获得的上限值提高至巴登初始攻击力的20%。
Increases the ATK stolen to 20% of the target's ATK and the cap for each steal to 20% of Baden's initial ATK.
巴登即将被击败时会夺舍幻影。
Baden possesses a phantom when he is about to be defeated.
自身被击败时若战场上存在自身创建的幻影，则会夺舍其中一个幻影并且在接下来8秒内不被敌人优先选为目标且受到伤害降低35%。该效果每场战斗至多触发3次。

When Baden is defeated, if any phantoms he created remain on the battlefield, he possesses one of them and will not be prioritized by enemies for the next 8s, and damage taken is reduced by 35%. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per battle.
